articles.title: Plaster, Shadows and Sketches Bring Lunar Features Into Art
articles.summary: An 1874 book made plaster moon models look remarkably convincing. A National Geographic Kids activity explores crater modelling and telescope sketches, with lighting and observation doing much of the work.

articles.title: Location Scouting Turns City Spaces Into Storytelling Tools
articles.summary: A beautiful room is only part of the puzzle. New York location professionals explain how permissions, crew size and creative choices shape the places you see on screen.

articles.title: Baldwin Biography Becomes the Basis for a Planned Feature Film
articles.summary: A researched life story is taking a new form. Nicholas Boggs and Marlon James will adapt Baldwin: A Love Story for a film produced by Higher Ground and Anonymous Content.
